# Digifab Quoting Full LLM Context

Generated: 2026-05-13 (curated 2026-10-01; kept by sync-agent-docs.py)

## Purpose

This file gives LLM agents a stable, tool-agnostic map for working in this
repository without depending on vendor-specific instruction files.

## Canonical instruction order

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `README.md` if present
3. `ECOSYSTEM.md` if present
4. Relevant files under `docs/`, `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`, and source
   directories for the specific task

## Agent compatibility

`AGENTS.md` is the source of truth. `CLAUDE.md` exists only to redirect Claude
and other legacy agent integrations to `AGENTS.md`.

## Enclii-first operations contract

Use Enclii web, API, or CLI for routine production provisioning, deployment,
observability, domain management, secrets, provider operations, scaling,
rollback, and remediation.

Raw `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs/APIs, `docker exec`, and direct
container access are allowed only for platform bootstrap or documented
break-glass emergencies when Enclii is unavailable or lacks an implemented
adapter. Any break-glass use must record the actor, reason, target
service/environment, commands executed, result, and follow-up Enclii adapter
gap or incident link.

## Repo entrypoints detected

- `README.md`
- `ECOSYSTEM.md`
- `docs/`
- `infra/`
- `.github/workflows/`

## Product and layout

Cotiza Studio is MADFAM's quoting engine for digital fabrication (FFF/SLA 3D
printing, 3-axis CNC, 2D laser) and for services quotes
(`Quote.quoteType === 'services'`, feature-flagged per tenant).

- `apps/api` — NestJS 10.4 + Prisma, REST under `/api/v1`. Prisma pool capped
  at 5 connections per pod.
- `apps/web` — Next.js 15.5.27 App Router, next-auth 4.24, ES/EN/pt-BR.
- `apps/worker` — Python FastAPI geometry and DFM analysis.
- `packages/pricing-engine`, `packages/shared`, `packages/ui`,
  `packages/client`, plus `cache`, `chaos`, `resilience` Nest helpers.
- `infra/k8s/production` — Kustomize manifests synced by ArgoCD.
- `infrastructure/terraform` — historical AWS reference, not the live stack.

## Deploy contract (verified 2026-10-01)

1. `Build & Deploy` (`build-deploy.yml`, api/web/worker; every push to `main`
   except changes limited to `**.md`/`docs/**`) and `Deploy API Only`
   (`deploy-api-only.yml`, api; path-filtered, `build_runner: ubuntu-24.04`)
   both call `madfam-org/enclii/.github/workflows/build-publish.yml@v1.0.0-alpha.9`.
2. Images go to `ghcr.io/madfam-org/digifab-quoting/<service>:<sha>`, signed
   with cosign. No `:latest`.
3. A bot commit `ci: pin image digests from <sha>` pins `@sha256:` digests in
   `infra/k8s/production/kustomization.yaml`; ArgoCD syncs namespace
   `digifab-quoting`.
4. Both callers share concurrency group `digifab-quoting-kustomization-<ref>`
   (no cancel), so pin commits are serialized.
5. `llms.txt`/`llms-full.txt` are not `**.md`, so editing them triggers a
   full no-op rebuild.
6. Migrations are never run by CI; production migrations are explicit
   operator actions.

Details: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` ("Current deploy path").

## Tests and CI gates

`ci.yml` gates PRs: NetworkPolicy port lint, no-TODO-auth grep, ESLint,
`prettier --check` over ts/tsx/js/jsx/json/css/md, `pnpm test` (turbo), API
tests with Postgres and Redis service containers, worker pytest (exit 5
accepted), build, Docker build per service, and typecheck of shared,
pricing-engine and ui. `Architecture Gate` and `Production Readiness Ratchet`
also run. `test.yml` is manual-only.

Known gaps: all 12 `@cotiza/pricing-engine` test files are excluded in its
`jest.config.js` (API drift; rewrite pending); `apps/worker` has no tests;
`apps/web` has no unit-test runner and its Playwright e2e runs only from
`test.yml`. No known flaky tests.

## Security invariant

- Invariant: `apps/web` runs with `images.unoptimized: true` and
  `remotePatterns: []`, so `/_next/image` returns 404; guarded by
  `apps/web/test/next-config.test.mjs` (CI "Config guard").

## Pending work

The single pending-work list, with priorities (P0-P3) and owner-decision vs
engineering labels, is `ROADMAP.md`, "Pending work". In short: the Pravara
dispatch and Dhanam milestone-invoice contract drifts (P1), the nodemailer 7
SESv2 transport move (P1), the excluded pricing-engine tests and missing
worker/web unit tests (P2), and `upload-artifact@v3` in the manual `test.yml`
(P3). Do not keep a separate list here.

## Maintenance

These files are maintained by `internal-devops/scripts/sync-agent-docs.py`,
which keeps curated llms files untouched.
If repo-specific long-form agent guidance is needed, put it in `AGENTS.md`,
not `CLAUDE.md`.
